content.rendered: Join us Tuesday, February 4th at Red Robin for our next Dinner Night Out! 20% of food sales will be donated back to Hawks View Elementary PAC. Show this flyer, or simply mention the fundraiser to your server to have your sales counted. If ordering online, please follow the instruction on the flyer.
